title: Rollout explainability sketch: developer-facing diagnostics for model rollouts
body:
Context / why this?
- We have strong infra for canaries and gradual traffic shifts (Dedicated + Hosted).
- Customers and internal platform users want more than a yes/no on whether a rollout is healthy — they want to know *why* (signals) and *what changed* (diffs between models/config).
- Current console shows numeric metrics + traces; but developers often open tickets saying: "requests spiked latency after rolling to model-4.1q" or "quality seems worse for intent X". We need a micro-UX + telemetry surface that makes the causal story easier to construct without digging into raw logs.

Goal / elevator pitch
- Provide ephemeral, per-rollout explainability views for engineers: a concise narrative (automatically generated), a list of top contributing signals (latency, error classes, token count distribution, prompt prefixes), and sample request diffs (before/after) with model outputs and simple quality heuristics.
- Make it trivial to answer: did this rollout degrade latency, cost, or quality and for which cohorts?

Primary users
- Platform engineers doing canary/AB rollouts
- Model owners (product/ML) validating external regressions
- SRE on-call triage during incidents

High level features (MVP scope)
1) Rollout summary card (auto-generated): short human-readable paragraph + bullet summary of top 3 signals
   - Auto paragraph like: "Canary 2025-02-10 -> 10% traffic to model-v2 caused median latency +15ms and 2.3% increase in rate-limited errors for traffic from eu-west1. Quality regressions detected for query-intent:search-help"
2) Top contributing signals (ranked list)
   - Latency deltas (median, p95, p99)
   - Error class increases (rate-limited, invalid-input, model-timeout)
   - Token distribution shifts (prompt length up/down)
   - Input-field regressions (e.g., more multi-turn sessions)
3) Cohort filtering UI (simple): by region, plan tier, route, path param, or label
   - Quick toggle to view only requests with prompt containing X or from mobile SDK
4) Sample diffs: 20 paired requests (pre-rollout / post-rollout) chosen by heuristics
   - Show inputs, outputs, and the following quick metrics: perplexity proxy, length, safety flags, token-cost delta, heuristic quality score (rule-based), human-labeled if available
5) Explainability notes: quick links to likely causes and suggested mitigations
   - e.g., "p99 latency regressed; check batching config and kernel selection for this model on gpus-a100-80gb"
6) Export & timeline
   - Export snapshot to Slack / ticket with a short template for incident notes

User stories (rough)
- As a platform engineer, I want a one-page explanation of a canary so I can decide to ramp or rollback in <15m.
- As an ML owner, I want to quickly see which intents saw quality drops so I can triage test-prompts.
- As SRE on-call, I want a compact sample of paired requests to triage a production regression without running the full trace job.

Acceptance criteria (MVP)
- Summary card generated within 10 minutes of canary starting (or when user opens view)
- Top signals show correct delta compared to baseline and are filterable by cohort
- Sample diffs present at least 20 paired requests with both inputs and outputs stored or indexed for 30 days
- Export to Slack/Linear with auto-filled evidence links

Telemetry & data needs
- Rollout metadata (id, commit/model-id, start/ramp percentages) from rollouts service
- Request-level metadata: route, route params, token_count, latency_ms, error_class, region, plan_tier, timestamp, model_version
- Persist minimal sample store (hash -> full request/response snapshot) for paired examples (privacy rules apply)
- Basic quality heuristics to run at ingest (e.g., similarity to golden prompts, hallucination heuristics, NER mismatch for structured tasks)

Privacy & compliance notes
- Default sampling policy should redact PII and adhere to customer data residency: samples from Private deployments should not leave customer VPC.
- For Hosted customers we may sample but must display a consent banner if output contains PII-like tokens.

Wireframe / micro-UX sketch (text)
- Top-left: Rollout summary paragraph + green/yellow/red health badge (computed by weighted signal)
- Top-right: controls (filter by cohort, time window, export)
- Middle-left: ranked signals with small sparkline deltas
- Middle-right: paired sample carousel (showing before vs after) with quick action buttons: "copy request", "add to eval set", "open trace"
- Bottom: Suggested mitigation checklist and links to infra runbooks

Implementation risks & open questions
- Risk: noise in automated summaries leading to false causal claims. Need guardrails & conservative language.
- Q: Where should the sample store live for Private deployments? (edge: inside customer VPC with ephemeral access tokens?)
- Q: How to compute "quality heuristics" for arbitrary tasks without heavy compute? Start with simple heuristics and surface a confidence score.
- Q: UX overload — don't recreate the full metrics page; keep it concise.

Operational plan for rollout of this rollout-explainability feature
- Phase 0: internal-only alpha for platform + a couple product teams. Export only to internal Slack channel.
- Phase 1: opt-in beta for Hosted customers; add consent & RBAC.
- Phase 2: make it default for org-admins with retention/PII controls.

Next immediate tasks (for me)
- Prototype sample-pair selection heuristic (start with p99 latency delta and random sampling of top error-class) -> code spike (2d)
- Draft UI copy for auto-summary and conservative templating (1d)
- Wire up minimal telem ingestion hook to store 20 paired snapshots (3d, infra help)
- Sync with Lena on privacy constraints for Private deployments (1x meeting)

Notes to self / brainstorming fragments
- Could we auto-suggest a rollback reason string that pre-fills a Linear ticket? (yes keep short list)
- Add an "explainability confidence" meter that shows how many distinct signals point to the same hypothesis
- Consider embedding small counterfactuals: e.g., show output if truncated prompt by last turn -> does quality change?
- Long-term: link to per-prompt evals and golden prompt sets in Optimize product

References and quick links
- local spike: github.com/ravi/repro-sample-spike (WIP)
- rollouts runbook: confluence:Rollouts-Runbook-v2
- related Linear: RD-1423 (canary telemetry gaps)

TODO (backlog)
- UX research: 3 interviews with platform engineers to validate summary language
- Add support for model-variant diffs where architecture changed (e.g., quantized vs fp16)
- Explore automated extraction of candidate "golden prompts" for each route

End.
